figurative_meaning_bn: আলস্য, কুঁড়েমি, ঢিলামি; দীর্ঘসূত্রতা; হচ্ছে হবে ভাব
figurative_meaning_en: Laziness, indolence, slackness; procrastination; the attitude of 'it will happen eventually'
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কাজে গড়িমসি করে, কখনো সময়মতো শেষ করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He procrastinates on work and never finishes on time.
Stop lazing around and start studying.
history: Derived from the observed sluggish behavior of cattle like cows and buffaloes in rural Bengal, reflecting agrarian lifestyle patterns.
note: The idiom captures the cultural observation of animal lethargy applied to human behavior.
